30A Escapes presents…"Ocean Ayer Main House”, a spacious 5-bedroom retreat in Seacrest Beach! Just steps from the iconic 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool with private beach access, this 3-story home features multiple balconies, a gas grill, and 7 bikes for exploring 30A. Sleeps 14 across 3 levels with designer furnishings and luxe amenities. Learn more below… 👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Prime Location in Seacrest Beach Between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach
✔ Sleeps 14 Comfortably with 5 Bedrooms
✔ Access to 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool – One of 30A’s Largest
✔ Private Community Beach Access with Seasonal Tram
✔ 7 Bikes Included for Guest Use
✔ Multiple Balconies and Outdoor Seating Areas Across 3 Floors
✔ Gourmet Kitchen with Stand-Alone Ice Maker and Seating for 6
✔ Gas Grill for Cookouts After the Beach

★☆ LIVING AREAS ☆★

Ocean Ayer Main House offers versatile living spaces designed for relaxation and connection. The main living area on the 1st floor is perfect for group gatherings, while each floor hosts ample outdoor seating with multiple balconies.
✔ 1st Floor Living Room: Cozy coastal furnishings, flat-screen TV, access to porch
✔ Multiple Balconies: Ample Outdoor Seating across all 3 floors

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

The spacious and fully stocked kitchen is designed to handle everything from beach snacks to gourmet dinners. A large island makes prep easy and doubles as a casual dining spot.
✔ Stainless Steel Appliances and Granite Countertops
✔ Stand-Alone Ice Maker
✔ Oversized Island with Seating for 6
✔ Dining Area with Seating for 6+
✔ Open Layout Ideal for Entertaining

★☆ OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ☆★

Soak up the Seacrest sunshine across multiple outdoor spaces perfect for relaxing, dining, and enjoying the Gulf breeze. With access to the famous Lagoon Pool and private beach, your 30A days start and end in comfort.

✔ Steps to 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool and Private Beach Access
✔ Gas Grill for Easy Outdoor Dining
✔ Multiple Porches and Balconies Across 3 Floors
✔ Outdoor Seating: 1st Floor Porch, 2nd Floor Balconies, 3rd Floor Balconies (Seating for 4–8)

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

1st Floor:
✔ Primary Suite: King Bed, Flat-Screen TV, En-suite with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub
✔ Half Bathroom: Convenient for Guests
✔ Laundry Room: Full-Size Washer and Dryer

2nd Floor:
✔ Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunks, Flat-Screen TV
✔ Guest Bathroom: Shower/Tub Combo
✔ Bunk Nook: Twin-over-Twin Bunk
✔ Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Flat-Screen TV, En-suite with Walk-In Shower
✔ Primary Suite: King Bed, Flat-Screen TV, En-suite with Walk-In Shower

3rd Floor:
✔ Guest Suite: King Murphy Bed, Sectional Sofa, Flat-Screen TV, Kitchenette
✔ Guest Bathroom: Walk-In Shower

★☆ ADDITIONAL ACCOMMODATIONS ☆★

Ocean Ayer Main House has a carriage house that rents separately called Ocean Ayer Carriage House. Ocean Ayer Carriage House is a one bedroom with a bunk nook that sleeps four with a full kitchen and living area.

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Nestled between the iconic Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Ocean Ayer Main House offers easy access to all the best Seacrest Beach has to offer. Located steps from the stunning 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool, you can also take a 4-Minute Bike Ride to the beach or hop on the seasonal tram for a quick ride with all your gear. With 7 bikes provided, exploring the area has never been easier or more fun.

✔ Lagoon Pool: 12,000 sq ft paradise with zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers
✔ Private Beach Access: Just a 4-minute bike ride or short tram ride to the pristine Gulf waters
✔ Peddler’s Pavilion: 2-minute bike ride to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife
✔ Scenic Walking Trails: Perfect for exploration, relaxation, and enjoying nature's beauty
✔ Walkable and Bike-Friendly: Easy stroll or bike ride to Rosemary Beach (8 minutes) and Alys Beach (12 minutes)
✔ South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes: Unique and stunning natural feature in the area

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.
✔ The driveway is shared with the carriage house and one parking space is available for Ocean Ayer Main House. The garage is not for guest use. Additional street parking is available on a first come, first serve basis. A parking pass is required for street parking and will be in the Seacrest amenity packet.
✔ The carriage house (Ocean Ayer Carriage House) is also available to rent. Please contact 30A Escapes for more information and pricing.

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★

responses.response: Thank you for sharing such an extraordinary review. We are thrilled to hear the home exceeded expectations for your bachelorette celebration and that the spacious layout, comfort, and décor helped make the weekend truly unforgettable. It is wonderful knowing the community shuttle, beautiful Lagoon Pool complex, and the exceptional kindness of the Seacrest Beach staff all contributed to such a seamless experience. We also truly appreciate your kind words about our team here at 30A Escapes. We would be honored to welcome you back for your next 30A getaway.

reviews.text: 100/10 bachelorette party experience. The property was AMAZING! It was even bigger than it looked in the pictures. It exceeded our expectations in every way. Not only were the 30A Escapes staff fantastic in every way, but every single staff member running the little neighborhood the house was located in were ABOVE AND BEYOND kind and provided great customer service. Our car battery died and the staff were literally SPRINTING around the neighborhood trying to find cables.I had never been to this area and was kind of hung up on trying to find a house on the side of the community closest to the beach; however this is not necessary at all!!!!!!!! It really makes no difference where your house is located in that neighborhood. You call their shuttle to pick you up and they were always there within a few minutes. Then it’s a beautiful and quick 3-5 minute ride to the beach. Same goes for the pool.The community pool also exceeded all expectations. Gorgeous, massive, plenty of seats for everyone, bar, and cafe. It was calm and relaxing while also acceptable to play music on your own speaker (at a respectful level) while sipping on drinks poolside with your friends. House was extremely clean, kitchen fully stocked, big washer/dryer, none of the ware and damage you typically see in rentals, comfortable furniture that didn’t feel cheap, the beds were like clouds. The decor was simple and matched the beachy blue wedding vibes of our bachelorette party’s decor.
